name: Disruption
text: The enemy cannot use Posture; any Empty Posture is always played as Empty Move (enemy cannot emit non-instant effects): their Posture or Empty Posture becomes an Empty Move that goes nowhere and emits nothing — a cast in progress is interrupted.

negate_kind.note: pass 2 (after Grapple): the enemy target's Posture (negated) and Empty Posture are played as Empty Move — noMove, and ctx.noEmit voids a non-instant emission (2026-11-16). JS this milestone.
